C1518.title: PyPI Package 'lightning' Hit by Supply Chain Attack, Stealing Developer Credentials and Poisoning Repositories
C1518.summary: On April 30, 2026, the PyTorch Lightning community was alerted that PyPI releases lightning 2.6.2 and 2.6.3 contained a hidden execution chain that downloaded and ran an external payload, creating a software supply-chain risk. Maintainers removed the affected releases, issued fixed versions, and rotated relevant credentials; the official account says remediation took about 42 minutes from the initial report.
